set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: description
parameters.explanation: The description text for the interface

unit [parameter2] family [parameter3] ad.explanation: Configure an interface with a specific unit, family, and IP address

parameters.name: unit number
parameters.explanation: The unit number of the interface

parameters.name: family type
parameters.explanation: The family type of the interface (e.g., inet for IPv4)

parameters.name: IP address with subnet
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask for the interface

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

delete interfaces [parameter1].explanation: The command fragment `delete interfaces [parameter1]` removes the configuration for the specified interface (`[parameter1]`) from the Junos device.

set interfaces [parameter1] [parameter2].explanation: Configure interface settings for a Gigabit Ethernet interface, specifying it as part of an 802.3ad link aggregation group

parameters.name: interface identifier
parameters.explanation: The specific interface to be configured, identified by its hardware path

parameters.name: configuration option
parameters.explanation: The type of configuration to apply to the interface

parameters.name: aggregation protocol
parameters.explanation: The protocol used for link aggregation, in this case 802.3ad

parameters.name: aggregated interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the aggregated interface to which this interface belongs

delete interfaces [parameter1] [paramete.explanation: Delete configuration or disable an interface

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be deleted or disabled

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to be performed on the interface, such as 'disable'

set routing-options static route [parame.explanation: This command configures a static route in Junos, where `[parameter1]` is the destination network and `[parameter2]` is the subnet mask.

next-hop [parameter3].explanation: Configures the static route, specifies the destination network and the next jump address.

parameters.name: next-hop
parameters.explanation: The next jump address will be forwarded to that address.
